items.summary: O chefe do Exército do Paquistão estava em Teerã nesta segunda-feira em uma missão de mediação, enquanto os Estados Unidos se preparavam para lançar “a maior ofensiva financeira de todos os tempos” contra os parceiros comerciais do Irã.
items.body:
O chefe do Exército do Paquistão estava em Teerã nesta segunda-feira em uma missão de mediação, enquanto os Estados Unidos se preparavam para lançar “a maior ofensiva financeira de todos os tempos” contra os parceiros comerciais do Irã.
O Irã rejeitou a ameaça dos EUA, prometendo interromper todas as exportações de petróleo do Golfo “se a guerra econômica continuar”. O país emitiu uma nova advertência aos navios para que não atravessassem o Estreito de Ormuz sem sua permissão, listando 45 embarcações que, segundo ele, teriam violado suas regras e ameaçando retaliar qualquer transferência de navio para navio envolvendo essas embarcações.
O secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, prometeu revelar medidas severas contra o Irã — que vem sofrendo sanções econômicas quase contínuas desde a Revolução Islâmica de 1979 — durante uma coletiva de imprensa marcada para 14h (horário de Brasília) desta segunda-feira.
“Ao amanhecer, começa um ‘Dia D’ econômico — a maior ofensiva financeira já mobilizada contra um adversário”, escreveu Bessent em um artigo de opinião publicado no Financial Times no domingo.
O chefe do Exército do Paquistão, Asim Munir, que construiu um relacionamento pessoal com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, chegou ao Irã na segunda-feira para conversações, informou a mídia iraniana. O Paquistão disse que a visita faz parte de seus esforços “para promover a paz e a estabilidade regionais”, e uma fonte paquistanesa declarou que Munir deveria se reunir com pessoas próximas ao líder supremo do Irã.
Duas fontes paquistanesas afirmaram que Trump ligou para Munir na semana passada, e uma outra disse que o principal pedido era fazer com que o Irã voltasse às negociações. A Casa Branca não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário.
EUA e Irã não realizam ataques aéreos contra as forças armadas um do outro há semanas, mas suas últimas negociações oficiais presenciais para pôr fim ao conflito, que já dura seis meses, ocorreram em junho, e os ataques a embarcações no Estreito de Ormuz continuaram.
Um projétil atingiu um petroleiro a oeste da cidade portuária saudita de Yanbu, no Mar Vermelho, na segunda-feira, causando um incêndio no convés principal, segundo informaram monitores de tráfego marítimo da Maritime Trade Operations, do Reino Unido. Eles não revelaram quem teria lançado o projétil. Os aliados houthis do Irã afirmaram no mês passado que bloqueariam as exportações de petróleo sauditas desviadas para o Mar Vermelho a fim de evitar o Estreito de Ormuz.
Milhares de pessoas morreram, a maioria delas no Irã e no Líbano, desde que EUA e Israel iniciaram os ataques em 28 de fevereiro, prejudicando grande parte da capacidade militar convencional do Irã e causando danos econômicos, além de terem matado o então líder supremo do Irã, aiatolá Ali Khamenei.
No entanto, o Irã preservou capacidade suficiente de mísseis e drones para atacar seus vizinhos do Golfo e praticamente paralisar a navegação no Estreito de Ormuz, elevando os preços mundiais dos combustíveis. O estado exato do programa nuclear iraniano, que os norte-americanos e israelenses pretendem eliminar, permanece desconhecido.
Os preços do petróleo recuaram na segunda-feira, após duas semanas de alta, à medida que os investidores realizaram lucros antes do anúncio esperado pelos EUA.
Sem detalhar medidas específicas, Bessent sinalizou que os EUA teriam como alvo “nações temerosas” que praticam a “apaziguamento” ao se envolverem com a economia e o sistema financeiro do Irã.
“Fariam bem em considerar as consequências de manter essa postura”, escreveu ele no Financial Times.
O Irã vem se preparando para as sanções há dias, emitindo uma série de declarações que sugerem uma resposta militar de grande porte.
Mohsen Rezaei, secretário do Conselho Supremo de Segurança Nacional do Irã, sugeriu, no domingo, uma retaliação econômica.
“Se a guerra econômica continuar, nem uma única gota de petróleo será exportada, nem pelo Estreito de Ormuz nem de qualquer outro lugar do Golfo Pérsico”, escreveu Rezaei em uma postagem nas redes sociais. “O Irã considerará a participação ou o apoio de qualquer país à guerra econômica dos Estados Unidos contra o povo iraniano como um ato de guerra.”

items.title: ロシア、穀物輸出への影響最小化へ措置　ウクライナ攻撃で供給懸念
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［モスクワ　２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モスクワ　２４日　ロイター］ - ロシア大統領府は２４日、ウクライナの攻撃がロシアの穀物輸出に与える影響を最小限に抑えるための措置を講じていると明らかにした。

黒海ではここ数週間、ロシアとウクライナの攻撃の応酬が繰り広げられ、穀物ターミナルが閉鎖され、輸出に支障をきたしている。

ペスコフ大統領報道官は記者団に対し、「対策は特定されており、さらに発展させ、輸出向けの全穀物が期日通りに完全に出荷されることを確実にする」と述べた。

プーチン大統領は先週、ロシアが農産物輸出で問題に直面していることを認め、解決すると述べた。また、世界市場で不足が生じることはないと約束した。

items.title: Rays' Drew Rasmussen eager to continue win streak in opener vs. Tigers
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays snapped a three-game losing streak on Sunday.
items.body:
The Tampa Bay Rays snapped a three-game losing streak on Sunday.
The American League East-leading Rays will try to build off that victory on Monday night in the opener of a three-game road series against the struggling Detroit Tigers.
Tampa Bay won 3-1 on Sunday to salvage the finale of a three-game series in Baltimore. Even with that victory, the Rays have dropped seven of their last 10 games but still hold a three-game advantage over the second-place New York Yankees in the division.
"I don't think we're firing on all cylinders right now, but you'll take it however you can get it," Tampa Bay manager Kevin Cash said.
The Rays scored all of their runs Sunday in the sixth inning. Nick Martinez and three relievers combined to hold the Orioles to two hits.
"At this time of year, and looking at our schedule, we're facing a lot of guys whose backs are up against the wall, right?" Martinez told MLB.com. "They have to win every game for them to make it to the playoffs, so we've just got to match the energy, bring the energy and keep playing to win ballgames.
"Keep doing what the game's asking us to do and playing our style, and things will turn around. Obviously you want to be winning every game you can, but the most important games are still in front of us."
Tampa Bay right-hander Drew Rasmussen (13-5, 3.01 ERA) will start the series opener against Detroit.
Rasmussen has recorded the victory in each of his last six starts, though the offense bailed him out in his last outing against Toronto on Wednesday. He gave up five runs in five innings, but the Rays won 7-6.
The two-time All-Star hasn't faced the Tigers this season. In four career outings (two starts) against them, he's 1-0 with a 1.69 ERA.
He'll oppose left-hander Framber Valdez (8-8, 4.35 ERA), who also picked up the victory in his last outing despite a tough start. He gave up five runs (four earned) in 5 2/3 innings against Pittsburgh in an 8-5 Detroit win on Monday.
That was the lone win in Detroit's last nine games. The Tigers were swept by last-place Kansas City over the weekend, including an 11-7 loss on Sunday, to complete a 1-5 road trip. They were swept in a three-game series by the first-place Chicago White Sox prior to the trip.
"We've got to pick ourselves up," Tigers manager A.J. Hinch said. "This was a miserable road trip, and the results make that pretty obvious. We show up every day ready to play. The environment is good. The want-to is there. We haven't executed perfectly, but we don't have to be perfect to win games. But at the end of the day, you either take a step forward or a step backward. We took a couple of steps backward on this trip, and we are wearing it."
The Tigers' current homestand will include a three-game set against the Los Angeles Dodgers.
"I understand the tough path we've created for ourselves," Hinch said of the Tigers, who are 3 1/2 games out of the AL's final wild-card spot. "But I don't care how bleak it looks. We need to show up ready to play against the Rays because they're pretty good."
Valdez is 2-1 with a 3.60 ERA in three career appearances (all starts) against Tampa Bay.
--Field Level Media

items.title: French far-left leader Melenchon seen reaching presidential runoff, poll shows
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the most likely rival to far-right candidate Marine Le Pen in next year's presidential run-off, a Monday poll showed, underlining a deeply polarised electorate as Emmanuel Macron's presidency draws to a close.
items.body:
French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the most likely rival to far-right candidate Marine Le Pen in next year's presidential run-off, a Monday poll showed, underlining a deeply polarised electorate as Emmanuel Macron's presidency draws to a close.
Melenchon, the candidate of the far-left France Unbowed (LFI) party, is seen reaching a run-off in at least three of the five scenarios polled, while he tied for second place in a fourth scenario. Le Pen is seen beating him easily in a run-off.
The poll makes sobering reading for France's centrist candidates who are struggling to reach an electorate that is increasingly polarised.
As Macron's second and final term comes to an end, the unpopular president leaves behind a hollowed-out political centre and weak economy, opening space for hardline parties, such as LFI and Le Pen's National Rally.
"The risk of Mrs Le Pen and Mr Melenchon facing each other in the second round is real and serious," centrist candidate Edouard Philippe told reporters on Monday.
Melenchon was seen winning around 16% to 17% in the first round, while Le Pen would get 35% to 38% of votes. Le Pen would win 64% of the votes against Melenchon in the run-off.
Melenchon has already run three times for president in 2012, 2017 and 2022 but has never managed to reach the second round.

items.title: Equinor, Aker BP and Vaar to cooperate on Norway frontier oil exploration
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Equinor , Aker BP and Vaar Energi plan to cooperate on oil and gas exploration in so-called high-impact frontier areas of Norway's continental shelf, the companies said on Monday.
items.body:
Equinor (EQNR.OL) , Aker BP (AKRBP.OL) and Vaar Energi (VAR.OL) plan to cooperate on oil and gas exploration in so-called high-impact frontier areas of Norway's continental shelf, the companies said on Monday.
Drilling in areas that have seen little or no prior exploration activity is more expensive than in mature regions and is associated with greater risk of drilling dry holes, but could also yield bigger finds.
The three companies have agreed to combine expertise, data, technology and exploration capacity to pursue selected high impact exploration opportunities, they said in a joint statement.
"Near-field exploration remains crucial, but we also need to pursue bigger opportunities to sustain activity and value creation beyond 2035," Kjetil Hove, Equinor's head of Norwegian operations, said in the statement.
Norway, Europe's largest oil and gas producer, [USN:L8N44I0B4 TEXT:"encourages energy firms to drill"] for more reserves, hoping to extend the life of its petroleum industry for decades to come despite concerns from environmental groups over the [USN:L6N44L0CB TEXT:"climate impact"].

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［モスクワ　２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モスクワ　２４日　ロイター］ - ロシア大統領府は２４日、英仏が共同開発した長距離巡航ミサイル「スカルプ」が使用する英国製部品の機密情報をウクライナに開示するという英国の決定は「火に油を注ぐ」ものだと非難した。

バーナム英首相は２４日、首相就任後初めてウクライナの首都キーウを訪問した。ウクライナでの長距離ミサイル生産能力向上に向けた支援措置を発表する予定だ。

ペスコフ大統領報道官は、英国が、最終的な和平協定に向けたあらゆる進展を妨げようとしていると非難。「英国はキーウ政権の側としてこの戦争に関与している。英国は計画的かつ定期的に火に油を注ぎ、平和的解決プロセスのわずかな進展すら妨げるような策を計画的かつ定期的に巡らしている」と述べた。その上で、ロシア軍はすでにミサイル製造施設の場所を特定するためのデータを体系的に収集し、破壊していると述べた。

ロシアは先週、英国製ドローンが初めてロシアへの長距離攻撃に使用されたとの報道を受け、英国が戦争への関与を深めていると非難し、「結果」を招くと警告した。これに対しバーナム氏は、英政府は「この違法な戦争」に対しウクライナを１００％支援することにコミットしていると述べていた。

BEIJING: Floods and landslides triggered by Typhoon Narra battered northern Vietnam and China's southern region of Guangxi, as accompanying heavy rains damaged infrastructure and crops.
Rising floodwaters prompted China to relocate about 54,000 people, including 8,087 moved to emergency shelters, state broadcaster CCTV said.
Days of heavy rain in northern Vietnam brought by Narra killed one and displaced more than 4,300 households.
Narra lingered over the Beibu Gulf, also known as the Gulf of Tonkin, but weather officials said it would not make landfall, and instead bring downpours in the north.

Vietnam's mountainous provinces of Lang Son and Cao Bang received between 236mm and 300mm of rain in the 24 hours to Monday (Aug 24) morning, triggering floods and landslides.

Floods also affected Vietnam's Quang Ninh, home to the UNESCO World Heritage site of Ha Long Bay, inundating parts of the city and disrupting tourism, fishing and transport.
The typhoon disrupted daily school and office activities, and snapped power links to nearly 55,000 families, authorities said, while destroying more than 10,000ha of rice and other crops.
In China, the waters of 15 rivers rose beyond warning levels at monitoring stations. Brown floodwaters engulfed parts of Chongzuo city in CCTV video, submerging roads and clusters of low-rise structures.
Chinese rescuers in rubber boots waded through knee-deep water, with some using boats to evacuate stranded residents.
Torrential rain is forecast for Guangxi, Guangdong, Hainan and Fujian in downpours expected to last through Wednesday, CCTV said.

items.title: 穀物輸送船への攻撃停止、ロシアは合意の用意ない＝ゼレンスキー氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [キーウ ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[キーウ ２４日 ロイター] -  ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、黒海で農産物を輸送する船舶への攻撃停止について、ロシアには「合意する用意がない」と述べた。ロシアは国内の製油所やパイプラインへの攻撃停止も合意に含めるよう求めていると指摘した。

ゼレンスキー氏は、２３日に公表が許可された記者団への発言で「一部の首脳に対し、各国の船舶を使ってウクライナの港から食料を輸送するよう提案した。ロシア産農産物を輸送しに来る船舶は攻撃しないとも伝えた」と述べた。

一方、ロシア側は、ウクライナがロシアのエネルギー施設への攻撃を停止すれば、ウクライナの穀物輸送回廊への攻撃をやめるという相互措置を求めているという。

ゼレンスキー氏は「（ロシアにとって）問題なのは穀物ではなく、エネルギー部門だ。しかし、この二つを同列に扱うことはできない」と述べた。

また、ウクライナがロシアの製油所や燃料輸送への攻撃を停止するには、ロシアもウクライナのエネルギーシステムへの攻撃を停止する必要があるとした。

items.title: Minério de ferro sobe com novos sinais de estímulos da China
items.author: Emily Yong
items.creator: Emily Yong
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do minério de ferro subiram nesta segunda-feira, impulsionados por novos sinais de estímulo da China e pelas expectativas de uma demanda mais forte antes do pico da temporada de construção, em setembro.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do minério de ferro subiram nesta segunda-feira, impulsionados por novos sinais de estímulo da China e pelas expectativas de uma demanda mais forte antes do pico da temporada de construção, em setembro.
O contrato de minério de ferro para janeiro mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian (DCE) da China fechou o pregão do dia com alta de 1,27%, a 716 iuanes (US$106,52) por tonelada.
A referência de minério de ferro para setembro na Bolsa de Cingapura subia 1,72%, para US$97,35 por tonelada.
A China lançará um novo pacote de medidas para expandir a demanda interna e impulsionar o crescimento econômico, afirmou o vice-ministro das Finanças, Liao Min, em uma coletiva de imprensa na sexta-feira, segundo a mídia estatal.
Separadamente, a Comissão Nacional de Desenvolvimento e Reforma da China realizou reuniões consecutivas na semana passada, instando os governos locais a acelerarem a construção de grandes projetos, segundo reportagens da mídia local.
A taxa de operação dos altos-fornos em 247 siderúrgicas subiu para 82,8% na semana passada, um aumento de 0,16 ponto percentual em relação à semana anterior, segundo dados da consultoria Mysteel.
Espera-se que o foco do mercado mude gradualmente no final de agosto, passando das condições fracas do período de baixa sazonal para as expectativas de melhora na demanda durante a alta temporada, afirmou Yang Huidan, analista da corretora chinesa Guoyuan Futures, em nota.
A reposição antecipada de estoques antes da alta temporada de setembro deverá ser uma força motriz de uma recuperação gradual dos preços do aço, disse Yang.
(Reportagem de Emily Ou Yong)

items.title: TotalEnergies will invest to expand Fujairah oil export pipeline in Abu Dhabi, CEO says
items.author: Nora Buli, Nerijus Adomaitis
items.creator: Nora Buli, Nerijus Adomaitis
items.summary: French oil major TotalEnergies will invest in expanding the Fujairah oil export pipeline in Abu Dhabi and continue investing in the Middle East despite the Iran war, its CEO said on Monday at an energy conference in Norway.
items.body:
French oil major TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) will invest in expanding the Fujairah oil export pipeline in Abu Dhabi and continue investing in the Middle East despite the Iran war , its CEO said on Monday at an energy conference in Norway.
Patrick Pouyanne has previously stated the importance of funding [USN:L6N42V108 TEXT:"alternate pipelines"] for oil to leave the Middle East given the paralysis in the Strait of Hormuz — which normally handles transit for a fifth of global oil supply — during the U.S. and Israeli war with Iran.
"We are today probably the largest trader of oil from Iraq or from Qatar ... and it's clear to me that I need to put a certain amount of equity to invest in an alternative route," Pouyanne said at the ONS conference.
"We will become partners of the pipeline moving from Baghdad to Syria, but I will also invest in Abu Dhabi, in doubling the Fujairah pipeline," he added.
The existing Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline, also known as the Habshan-Fujairah pipeline, can carry up to 1.8 million barrels per day and has proved crucial as the United Arab Emirates seeks to maximise exports from the Gulf of Oman coast, just outside the Strait of Hormuz.
The UAE hopes to [USN:L6N41S0IK TEXT:"double"] that export capacity by next year.

items.title: Futures S&P, Nasdaq in calo, mercati attendono sanzioni Iran, risultati Nvidia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: I futures sull’S&P 500 e sul Nasdaq sono in calo mentre gli investitori si preparano ad affrontare una importante settimana segnata dalla prospettiva di nuove sanzioni Usa contro l’Iran, dal discorso del presidente della Fed Kevin Warsh a Jackson Hole e dai risultati di Nvidia, società di riferimento per l'IA.
items.body:
I futures sull’S&P 500 e sul Nasdaq sono in calo mentre gli investitori si preparano ad affrontare una importante settimana segnata dalla prospettiva di nuove sanzioni Usa contro l’Iran, dal discorso del presidente della Fed Kevin Warsh a Jackson Hole e dai risultati di Nvidia, società di riferimento per l'IA.
** Gli Stati Uniti sono pronti a introdurre sanzioni economiche contro i partner commerciali dell’Iran, in quella che ha definito "la più grande offensiva finanziaria di sempre" e il segretario al Tesoro Scott Bessent terrà una conferenza stampa in serata.
** I prezzi del greggio scendono di oltre 1 dollaro il barile, con gli investitori impegnati nelle prese di profitto dopo i recenti rialzi in vista dell’annuncio.
** I timori per l’aumento dei prezzi dell’energia e il debito pubblico in forte crescita hanno spinto al rialzo i rendimenti dei titoli del Tesoro Usa la scorsa settimana, con il rendimento del 30 anni che ha toccato i massimi degli ultimi 19 anni, prima che il Tesoro annunciasse misure di sostegno.
** L'impennata dei rendimenti ha messo sotto pressione i titoli tech, orientati alla crescita, lasciando il settore Information Technology dell'S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) in calo di oltre il 3% sull'intera settimana.
** La pressione rimane elevata anche all'inizio di questa settimana, mentre l'attenzione degli investitori si sposta ai risultati trimestrali di Nvidia, la società con la maggiore capitalizzazione di mercato al mondo, attesi per mercoledì. Qualsiasi segnale di rallentamento della crescita potrebbe riaccendere i timori sulle valutazioni troppo elevate e sulla sostenibilità del rally guidato dall'intelligenza artificiale.
** "Anche risultati eccezionali potrebbero non garantire una reazione positiva, visto il recente deterioramento del sentiment nei confronti dei colossi dell’IA", ha affermato Ipek Ozkardeskaya, analista senior presso Swissquote Bank.
** "Con gli ottimi utili del secondo trimestre già scontati nei prezzi, i timori relativi ai finanziamenti per l’intelligenza artificiale e le notizie di carattere politico e geopolitico stanno gradualmente prendendo il sopravvento sull’andamento del mercato", ha aggiunto.
** Sabato Bloomberg News ha scritto che ad alcuni dei maggiori clienti di Nvidia è stato comunicato che i prezzi dei server dotati dei suoi chip per l’IA aumenteranno, in molti casi, di oltre il 15%.
** Oggi l’andamento delle megacap è misto: APPLE (AAPL.O) , NVIDIA (NVDA.O) e AMAZON.COM (AMZN.O) registrano un rialzo rispettivamente dello 0,4%, dello 0,1% e dello 0,02% nel premarket, mentre ALPHABET (GOOGL.O) perde lo 0,3%.
** Anche la maggior parte dei produttori di chip è in calo. Tra le società di archiviazione dati SANDISK (SNDK.O) perde il 5% e SEAGATE (STX.O) cede il 3,3%.
** Il titolo di ALIBABA (9988.HK) , quotato negli Stati Uniti perde il 2,2% dopo che il gigante cinese dell’e-commerce ha lanciato una vendita di azioni da 10,2 miliardi di dollari con uno sconto consistente per finanziare le proprie ambizioni nel campo dell’IA.
** Alle 12.30 italiane i futures E-mini sul Dow sono in calo dello 0,04%, i futures E-mini sull'S&P 500 perdono lo 0,15% e i futures E-mini sul Nasdaq 100 cedono lo 0,53%.
** Nel frattempo, il discorso di Warsh al simposio annuale della Fed a Jackson Hole, in Wyoming, sarà seguito con grande attenzione questa settimana alla ricerca di indicazioni su come la banca centrale intenda gestire la politica monetaria in un contesto di aumento dei prezzi del greggio e dei rendimenti dei titoli di Stato.
** "Non sappiamo più chi controllerà in definitiva la parte lunga della curva dei rendimenti Usa: il Tesoro, la Fed o il mercato obbligazionario stesso ... Dopo la reazione della scorsa settimana all’annuncio del Tesoro, è ancora il mercato ad avere l’ultima parola", ha affermato Ozkardeskaya.
** "L’incontro di Jackson Hole farà un po’ di chiarezza su come la Fed si inserirà in questo contesto", ha aggiunto.
** Secondo i dati Lseg, gli operatori del mercato monetario stanno già prezzando pienamente un rialzo dei tassi di interesse di 25 punti base entro la fine del 2026. I dati favorevoli sull’inflazione pubblicati a inizio agosto ha però ridotto significativamente le probabilità di un rialzo immediato.

items.title: Irã ameaça 45 petroleiros com multas e confisco em meio a escalada no Estreito de Ormuz
items.author: Nidhi Verma, Florence Tan
items.creator: Nidhi Verma, Florence Tan
items.summary: O Irã afirmou ter colocado na lista negra 45 petroleiros que violaram suas regras para a travessia do Estreito de Ormuz e que tomaria medidas contra quaisquer embarcações que transferissem cargas com eles, intensificando suas ameaças em relação à importante via navegável seis meses após o início da guerra.
items.body:
O Irã afirmou ter colocado na lista negra 45 petroleiros que violaram suas regras para a travessia do Estreito de Ormuz e que tomaria medidas contra quaisquer embarcações que transferissem cargas com eles, intensificando suas ameaças em relação à importante via navegável seis meses após o início da guerra.
As embarcações citadas podem ser multadas, detidas e ter suas cargas confiscadas, de acordo com uma publicação no X no final do domingo pela Autoridade do Estreito do Golfo Pérsico, um novo órgão criado pelo Irã para administrar o estreito.
A advertência foi emitida poucos dias depois de os EUA terem ameaçado o Irã com “as sanções mais duras da história” e de o Irã ter afirmado que sua resposta a quaisquer novas ameaças dos EUA seria “devastadora”.
A lista de restrições inclui superpetroleiros, navios-tanque de gás natural liquefeito e gás de petróleo liquefeito, além de navios de produtos refinados, entre outros.
Alguns dos navios citados pertencem à ADNOC Logistics and Shipping (ADNOC L&S) dos Emirados Árabes Unidos, à Navig8 Tankers, subsidiária da ADNOC, e à Bahri, empresa nacional de navegação da Arábia Saudita.
Quaisquer embarcações envolvidas em transferências de navio para navio com as embarcações citadas poderiam ser adicionadas à lista negra, acrescentou a publicação iraniana no X.
A publicação não especificou o que entendia por “regras do Irã”, mas Teerã já havia afirmado, no passado, que os armadores deveriam obter sua autorização para transitar pelo estreito e que os navios deveriam pagar por serviços de segurança e outros.
Os EUA também impuseram um bloqueio naval contra o transporte marítimo relacionado ao Irã.
O Golfo fornecia cerca de 20% do petróleo e do gás natural liquefeito diários do mundo antes que o conflito com o Irã interrompesse o tráfego de petroleiros.
Esforços coordenados pelos EUA para conduzir petroleiros discretamente pelo Estreito de Ormuz, a fim de abastecer superpetroleiros que aguardam logo fora dele, estão ajudando a restaurar parte desses volumes de exportação.
O secretário de Energia dos EUA, Chris Wright, afirmou na sexta-feira no X que “a média de sete dias do petróleo que sai do estreito é superior a 8 milhões de barris por dia. Não se enganem: graças à Marinha dos EUA, o petróleo está fluindo pelo Estreito de Ormuz”.
Navios de propriedade da Klaveness Ship Management, da Stolt Tankers e da sul-coreana Sinokor também foram incluídos na lista negra.
As empresas de navegação não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário da Reuters.

items.title: Xpengs Roboter-Sparte mehr als 6,3 Milliarden Dollar wert
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die Roboter-Sparte des chinesischen Autobauers Xpeng hat bei ihrer ersten Finanzierungsrunde mehr als 900 Millionen Dollar eingesammelt. Damit werde der Bereich mit über 6,3 Milliarden Dollar bewertet, teilte das Unternehmen am Montag mit. Die Runde, die von IDG Capital angeführt und von den strategischen Investoren Tencent und Alibaba unterstützt wurde, stellt einen neuen Rekord für eine einzelne private Finanzierung im chinesischen Sektor für physische Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) auf.
items.body:
Die Roboter-Sparte des chinesischen Autobauers Xpeng (9868.HK) hat bei ihrer ersten Finanzierungsrunde mehr als 900 Millionen Dollar eingesammelt. Damit werde der Bereich mit über 6,3 Milliarden Dollar bewertet, teilte das Unternehmen am Montag mit. Die Runde, die von IDG Capital angeführt und von den strategischen Investoren Tencent (0700.HK) und Alibaba (9988.HK) unterstützt wurde, stellt einen neuen Rekord für eine einzelne private Finanzierung im chinesischen Sektor für physische Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) auf.
Die Mittel sollen in die Entwicklung von Hard- und Software, das Training von KI-Modellen sowie den Aufbau von Anlagen für die Serienfertigung fließen. Zudem sei eine weltweite Expansion geplant, hieß es. Xpeng will bis Ende des Jahres mit der Serienproduktion seines humanoiden Roboters "Xpeng IRON" beginnen. Dieser soll zunächst in den eigenen Einzelhandelsgeschäften und auf den Werksgeländen eingesetzt werden. Der kommerzielle Verkauf und die Auslieferung in China sowie auf ausländischen Märkten sind für 2027 vorgesehen.

items.title: Norris showing more self-confidence, says Stella after Dutch win
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: McLaren team boss Andrea Stella says Lando Norris is showing more self-confidence and being rewarded with his results.
items.body:
McLaren team boss Andrea Stella says Lando Norris is showing more self-confidence and being rewarded with his results.
The reigning Formula One champion won Sunday's Dutch Grand Prix from pole position, his second successive victory and career 13th, but he had to earn it by passing Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli after losing the lead at a restart.
The Briton is still 83 points off the lead but whittling away at the deficit.
"I would say that definitely he is now expressing a higher level of assertiveness," Stella told reporters at Zandvoort.
"The manoeuvre to pass Antonelli I think is a really good demonstration of that. He is demonstrating more self-confidence.
"This is interesting and I quite like it, sometimes it is not demonstrated by being the most aggressive. Sometimes you are self-confident when you think like 'you know what, I'm not going to have a fight now because I may lose in this fight. It's a very long race, see you at the end',"
Stella said that meant having the confidence to back off, while having faith in being able to come through in the long run. He pointed out that in Hungary and the Netherlands, Norris had lost the pole advantage but not his confidence.
"I think assertiveness and confidence are probably the two characteristics that he has improved the most from a non-technical, non-operational point of view," added Stella.
Norris has said the new generation of cars are difficult to drive and he has had to adapt his style to accommodate that. He also gave himself plenty of credit for Sunday's win, saying a driver could still make the difference.
Stella agreed the Briton was driving like a champion and constantly improving, a process that started early in 2025 when "something clicked".
"I think this approach has led Lando to continuous improvements. It's almost like I see Lando stronger and stronger race by race."
Australian teammate Oscar Piastri has meanwhile gone a year since he last won a race, from pole at Zandvoort last August.
Piastri finished sixth on Sunday, 32 seconds behind Norris and hampered by a slow pitstop that cost him a place on a frustrating afternoon.
Stella said the result was not a fair reflection of Piastri's competitiveness through the sprint weekend.

items.author: Reuters

items.summary: I prezzi del greggio sono in calo di oltre 1 dollaro il barile, sulle prese di profitto degli investitori dopo i recenti rialzi, in attesa dei dettagli sulle nuove sanzioni statunitensi contro l’Iran che potrebbero ostacolare ulteriormente le forniture dal Medio Oriente.
items.body:
I prezzi del greggio sono in calo di oltre 1 dollaro il barile, sulle prese di profitto degli investitori dopo i recenti rialzi, in attesa dei dettagli sulle nuove sanzioni statunitensi contro l’Iran che potrebbero ostacolare ulteriormente le forniture dal Medio Oriente.
** I futures sul Brent scendono dell’1,64%, a 92,84 dollari alle 12.15, mentre il West Texas Intermediate si attesta a 85,08 dollari, in calo del 2,3%.
** Il segretario al Tesoro degli Stati Uniti Scott Bessent, che terrà una conferenza stampa alle 19 ore italiane, ha minacciato di imporre all’Iran “le sanzioni più dure della storia”. Anche il presidente Usa Donald Trump ha detto che colpirà i partner commerciali dell'Iran attraverso delle sanzioni.
** Teheran ha condannato i piani degli Stati Uniti e il presidente Masoud Pezeshkian ha invocato una soluzione diplomatica. Il capo dell’esercito pakistano si trova oggi in visita in Iran in una missione di mediazione.
** Secondo i dati sul traffico marittimo, nel fine settimana meno di 20 navi da carico hanno attraversato lo Stretto di Hormuz, a causa dei blocchi imposti da Iran e Stati Uniti.
** L’Iran ha tuttavia autorizzato alcune petroliere irachene a transitare per lo Stretto, accogliendo le ripetute richieste di Baghdad, come riportato sabato dall’agenzia di stampa statale iraniana Irna.
** Parallelamente, sia la compagnia petrolifera irachena Somo che QatarEnergy starebbero offrendo greggio da caricare all'interno dello Stretto attraverso gare d'appalto, secondo quanto riferito da fonti del settore a Reuters.

"The manoeuvre to pass Antonelli I think is a really good demonstration of that. He is demonstrating more self-confidence.
"This is interesting and I quite like it, sometimes it is not demonstrated by being the most aggressive. Sometimes you are self-confident when you think like 'you know what, I'm not going to have a fight now because I may lose in this fight. It's a very long race, see you at the end',"
Stella said that meant having the confidence to back off, while having faith in being able to come through in the long run. He pointed out that in Hungary and the Netherlands, Norris had lost the pole advantage but not his confidence.
"I think assertiveness and confidence are probably the two characteristics that he has improved the most from a non-technical, non-operational point of view," added Stella.
Norris has said the new generation of cars are difficult to drive and he has had to adapt his style to accommodate that. He also gave himself plenty of credit for Sunday's win, saying a driver could still make the difference.
Stella agreed the Briton was driving like a champion and constantly improving, a process that started early in 2025 when "something clicked".
"I think this approach has led Lando to continuous improvements. It's almost like I see Lando stronger and stronger race by race."
Australian teammate Oscar Piastri has meanwhile gone a year since he last won a race, from pole at Zandvoort last August.
Piastri finished sixth on Sunday, 32 seconds behind Norris and hampered by a slow pitstop that cost him a place on a frustrating afternoon.
Stella said the result was not a fair reflection of Piastri's competitiveness through the sprint weekend.

items.title: China's $119 billion policy financing tool begins project applications, faces roll-out lag
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China has opened applications for an 800 billion yuan ($119 billion) policy-based financing tool for local government projects to shore up slowing economic growth, although a securities firm said the later roll-out could limit its impact this year.
items.body:
China has opened applications for an 800 billion yuan ($119 billion) policy-based financing tool for local government projects to shore up slowing economic growth, although a securities firm said the later roll-out could limit its impact this year.
China's fixed-asset investment [USN:L1N44E058 TEXT:"contracted"] 6.7% in the first seven months of 2026. Reuters [USN:L8N43F05Z TEXT:"reported"] previously the decline came as local officials faced stricter scrutiny of capital spending, which authorities blame for unproductive infrastructure projects, industrial overcapacity and deflationary price wars among manufacturers.
Implementation guidelines have been circulated to local authorities, which are now compiling and submitting eligible projects to Beijing for review, according to the state-backed Economic Information Daily.
The process from application through to fund disbursement is likely to take at least a month, Caitong Securities said in a report on August 20, suggesting the tool may provide only limited support to financing demand and construction activity this year.
MORE STIMULUS NEEDED AS GROWTH SLOWS The instrument, announced by the government in March, is a quasi-fiscal tool designed to provide project capital and leverage larger amounts of private and bank financing for infrastructure and strategic sectors. Beijing increased its size from 500 billion yuan in 2025.
Economists said the instrument was not used in the first half of the year due to a shortage of eligible projects amid local debt curbs and less need for stimulus after China's economy started the year on a relatively firm footing.
The country's GDP growth slowed to 4.3% in the second quarter, the [USN:L1N43H01A TEXT:"slowest in more than three years"] and below forecasts. It grew 5.0% in the first quarter.
The tool is designed to provide project capital and ease financing constraints for projects already in the planning stage or with preliminary approvals, rather than create entirely new investment demand, Caitong Securities said.
Caitong estimates that the 800 billion yuan programme could support around 10 trillion yuan in total project investment, assuming a leverage ratio of about 13 times. But the direct boost to investment within this year may be closer to 2 trillion yuan, or two to three times the initial funding, because of implementation delays and a shortage of bankable projects.
It expects policy bank bond issuance to accelerate in August and September, while local governments may also [USN:L1N44I01C TEXT:"speed"] sales of special-purpose bonds tied to approved projects.
Assuming the tool for this year will be implemented in the third quarter, Goldman Sachs analysts estimate a baseline GDP impact of 0.5 percentage points, probably concentrated in late 2026 and early 2027.
($1 = 6.7231 Chinese yuan renminbi)

items.title: China state-owned firms, JD.com for JV to invest in Hong Kong border mega project
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A joint venture comprising six companies said on Monday it plans to invest HK$16.8 billion ($2.14 billion) in the newly awarded pilot development area in Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis, a mega project bordering mainland China.
items.body:
A joint venture comprising six companies said on Monday it plans to invest HK$16.8 billion ($2.14 billion) in the newly awarded pilot development area in Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis, a mega project bordering mainland China.
The six companies include Chinese state-owned property developers China Overseas Land & Investment (0688.HK) , China Merchants Land (0978.HK) , China Resources Land (Overseas) and Hong Kong peer Sino Land (0083.HK) .
Another two companies are China's state-owned tourism enterprise CTG Investment Management and e-commerce giant JD.com Inc (9618.HK) .
The joint venture plans to develop a large-scale modern logistics hub with residential and community commercial facilities.
It expects the logistic facility will begin operations in 55 months.
Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis, spanning 30,000 hectares (116 square miles), aims to bolster the city's technological collaboration and linkages with mainland China.
The joint venture won the tender of the project on Monday for HK$1 billion.
($1 = 7.8367 Hong Kong dollars)

items.title: Pakistan vermittelt im Iran - USA drohen mit härtesten Sanktionen
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Unter dem Druck massiver Sanktionsdrohungen der USA gegen den Iran nimmt Pakistan einen neuen Anlauf für Vermittlungen. Armeechef Asim Munir traf am Montag im Iran ein, wie dortige Medien berichteten. Laut der pakistanischen Regierung sollen Munirs Gespräche Bemühungen um Frieden und Stabilität in der Region voranbringen. Munir, der eine persönliche Beziehung zu US-Präsident Donald Trump aufgebaut hat, soll pakistanischen Kreisen zufolge mit Personen aus dem Umfeld des Obersten Führers Modschtaba Chamenei zusammenkommen. US-Finanzminister Scott Bessent will am Mittag (US-Ortszeit) Details zu den angekündigten "härtesten Sanktionen der Geschichte" nennen. In der "Financial Times" sprach er von einem "Economic D-Day".
items.body:
Unter dem Druck massiver Sanktionsdrohungen der USA gegen den Iran nimmt Pakistan einen neuen Anlauf für Vermittlungen. Armeechef Asim Munir traf am Montag im Iran ein, wie dortige Medien berichteten. Laut der pakistanischen Regierung sollen Munirs Gespräche Bemühungen um Frieden und Stabilität in der Region voranbringen. Munir, der eine persönliche Beziehung zu US-Präsident Donald Trump aufgebaut hat, soll pakistanischen Kreisen zufolge mit Personen aus dem Umfeld des Obersten Führers Modschtaba Chamenei zusammenkommen. US-Finanzminister Scott Bessent will am Mittag (US-Ortszeit) Details zu den angekündigten "härtesten Sanktionen der Geschichte" nennen. In der "Financial Times" sprach er von einem "Economic D-Day".
Bessent betonte, maximaler wirtschaftlicher Druck verringere die Wahrscheinlichkeit einer Wiederaufnahme groß angelegter militärischer Handlungen. Die Maßnahmen sollen eine bestehende Blockade ergänzen. Trump hatte allen Ländern mit wirtschaftlichen Konsequenzen gedroht, die dem Iran in irgendeiner Form helfen. Mit den nun bevorstehenden Maßnahmen wollen die USA die iranische Führung zum Zusammenbruch bringen.
Die Regierung in Teheran wies die Drohungen zurück. Sollte der Wirtschaftskrieg andauern, werde man sämtliche Ölexporte aus der Golfregion stoppen, hieß es. Zudem warnte der Iran die Schifffahrt davor, die Straße von Hormus ohne seine Erlaubnis zu passieren. Am Dienstag wird der omanische Außenminister in Teheran erwartet, um über die Situation in der Meerenge zwischen dem Iran und dem Oman zu beraten.
Militärische Konfrontationen zwischen den USA und dem Iran hat es seit Wochen nicht mehr gegeben. Seit Juni haben beide Seiten allerdings auch nicht mehr über ein Ende des Krieges beraten. Seit dem Beginn der Angriffe der USA und Israels auf den am 28. Februar sind Tausende Menschen ums Leben gekommen, die meisten von ihnen im Iran und im Libanon.
Die Militärschläge haben die konventionellen Streitkräfte des Irans stark geschwächt und dem Land bereits schweren wirtschaftlichen Schaden zugefügt. Allerdings bleiben dem Iran weiter ausreichend Raketen und Drohnen, um benachbarte Golfstaaten anzugreifen und mit Angriffen auf die Schifffahrt die für Öltransporte wichtige Straße von Hormus zu blockieren. Seit der Islamischen Revolution im Jahr 1979 hat es fast durchgängig Wirtschaftssanktionen gegen den Iran gegeben.

items.title: Chinese refiner Sinopec to boost oil imports from outside the Gulf
items.author: Sam Li, Alison Lui
items.creator: Sam Li, Alison Lui
items.summary: Chinese refiner Sinopec will increase the sourcing of its oil from Brazil, Africa and beyond to contend with supply disruptions caused by Middle East conflict, company executives said on Monday after reporting interim results on Sunday.
items.body:
Chinese refiner Sinopec (600028.SS) will increase the sourcing of its oil from Brazil, Africa and beyond to contend with supply disruptions caused by Middle East conflict, company executives said on Monday after reporting interim results on Sunday.
Sinopec had [USN:L1N44K01F TEXT:"posted a 19% rise"] in first-half net profit despite its heavy exposure to the oil supply disruptions and government curbs on passing higher oil prices on to consumers.
The company will continue to deepen relations with "stable" producing nations such as Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, it said.
USING 'ALL POSSIBLE MEANS' TO SECURE CRUDE OIL Sinopec "will try all possible means" to secure crude oil, including from Saudi's Red Sea port of Yanbu and UAE oil exports piped to loading points outside the Gulf, Chairman Hou Qijun told an earnings briefing in Hong Kong.
The refiner has crude oil stocks for 20 days of processing and refined fuel for 15 days of sales, Sinopec President Wan Tao said.
Wan did not disclose details on the use of government-controlled oil stockpiles, apart from saying the company will follow the rules for tapping reserves.
Sinopec's second-quarter refinery throughput slumped 17% from the first quarter and domestic refined fuel sales tumbled by 18%, a stock market filing showed on Sunday. To maintain flat processing volumes in the second half, its annual crude throughput needs to be about 4.52 million barrels per day, down 10% from 2025, Reuters calculations show.
The company plans to allocate about 20% of its capital spending, or more than 30 billion yuan a year, on new energy and new materials over 2026 to 2030, Hou said, as the state giant squares up to the challenges of falling fuel demand and petrochemicals overcapacity.
China's oil consumption may have peaked last year and refined fuel use is expected to fall by 8% this year after registering a similar year-on-year decline in the first half, outpacing a forecast 4-5% drop, company officials said.

items.title: Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro neck and neck ahead of Brazil election, Nexus poll shows
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in a potential runoff ahead of October's presidential election, a Nexus poll commissioned by lender BTG Pactual showed on Monday.
items.body:
Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in a potential runoff ahead of October's presidential election, a Nexus poll commissioned by lender BTG Pactual showed on Monday.
In a simulated second-round runoff, Lula would receive 46% of voter support compared with 45% for Bolsonaro.
An [USN:L1N44E09D TEXT:"August 17 poll"] had Lula leading Bolsonaro 47%-44%.
In a first-round scenario, Lula would lead with 41% of the votes, followed by Bolsonaro (37%), Ronaldo Caiado (5%), Renan Santos (3%) and Romeu Zema (3%).
The previous poll showed Lula at 41% and Bolsonaro at 36% in the first round.
If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes in the first round, the two frontrunners advance to a runoff.
Nexus surveyed 2,006 people between August 21-23; margin of error 2 percentage points.

items.title: Jackson Hole-Le premier discours de Warsh sous surveillance avec l'agitation sur l'obligataire
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le discours de Kevin Warsh, président de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed), lors de la conférence de Jackson Hole qui débute cette semaine, suscitera sans aucun doute un intérêt allant bien au-delà de l'évidence, à un moment où le marché cherche des éclaircissements sur la récente flambée des rendements obligataires et des garanties quant à l'indépendance de la banque centrale.
items.body:
Le discours de Kevin Warsh, président de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed), lors de la conférence de Jackson Hole qui débute cette semaine, suscitera sans aucun doute un intérêt allant bien au-delà de l'évidence, à un moment où le marché cherche des éclaircissements sur la récente flambée des rendements obligataires et des garanties quant à l'indépendance de la banque centrale.
Le patron de la Fed s'est jusqu'à présent montré réticent à s'exprimer sur ses projets en matière de politique économique, affirmant qu'il souhaitait attendre les recommandations des cinq groupes de travail créés au début de son mandat ce printemps avant de donner plus de détails.
Les marchés ont toutefois conclu que le taux d'intérêt de référence de la banque centrale devrait être plus élevé, l'inflation se situant depuis plus de cinq ans au-dessus de l'objectif de 2%, tandis que les collègues de Kevin Warsh au sein de l'institution monétaire craignent que la crédibilité de cette dernière ne soit compromise si aucune mesure n'est prise.
"L'excédent d'épargne mondial" évoqué par l'ancien président de la Fed et lauréat du prix Nobel d'Economie, Ben Bernanke, a cédé la place à une contraction mondiale de l'épargne, sur fond d'augmentation de la dette publique, de fragmentation du commerce international et des chaînes d'approvisionnement, de coûts liés au vieillissement de la population et de l'essor de l'intelligence artificielle (IA), autant d'éléments qui se disputent aujourd'hui les investissements et le crédit.
"Le marché obligataire et le FOMC ont clairement décidé de se réveiller" pour tenir compte de l'inflation plus élevée et de ce qui promet de devenir "une tendance haussière séculaire et pluriannuelle des taux d'intérêt", souligne Adam Posen, président du Peterson Institute for International Economics.
Il estime que le président de la Fed, qui prononcera vendredi son premier discours lors du colloque économique, devrait moins se concentrer sur les projets à long terme et davantage sur la manière dont la banque centrale évalue la situation économique actuelle, ainsi que sur les implications des récents événements sur les marchés mondiaux.
L'OMBRE DU TRÉSOR La conférence incontournable qui se tient chaque année à cette période dans le Wyoming offre aux responsables des banques centrales un forum privilégié pour donner le ton ou faire passer un message fort.
L'ancien président de la Fed Jerome Powell a, par exemple, profité de cet événement pour présenter un nouveau cadre de politique monétaire, puis réaffirmer son engagement à lutter contre l'inflation, ce qui avait à l'époque contribué à ancrer les anticipations du marché quant à une série de hausses rapides des taux d'intérêt.
Toutefois, interrogé par les journalistes après la réunion de juillet sur ses projets de discours, l'actuel dirigeant de l'institution a souligné son souhait d'"aborder les questions fondamentales".
"On a tendance, notamment avec la multiplication des réunions et des conférences de presse, à se perdre dans une vision à court terme", avait-il dit.
Depuis lors, tout s'est compliqué.
La récente augmentation des rendements des obligations américaines et de leurs homologues mondiales à des niveaux jamais vus depuis près de deux décennies, conjuguée à la décision du secrétaire au Trésor, Scott Bessent, de doubler ses achats de dette à long terme, soulève la possibilité que Kevin Warsh doive composer avec un Trésor plus interventionniste et avec la hausse des coûts de la dette publique.
En théorie, cela ne concerne pas la Fed, à moins que le financement ne commence à faiblir ou que les décisions du Trésor n'influencent les taux d'intérêt à court terme.
L'impact sur le dollar, qui s'est déprécié au cours du dernier mois par rapport à d'autres devises majeures, pourrait également contribuer à l'inflation.
"Nous vivons dans un contexte où la politique interventionniste du Trésor est aussi déterminante – pour le meilleur et pour le pire – que la politique des banques centrales. L'interaction entre les deux sera essentielle pour les perspectives économiques", écrivait la semaine dernière Krishna Guha, ancien haut responsable de la Fed de New York et actuel vice-président d'Evercore ISI.
TROUVER SES MARQUES Le président Donald Trump s'est jusqu'à présent abstenu de critiquer Kevin Warsh, qu'il a lui-même choisi pour occuper le poste le plus élevé de la Fed, pour ne pas avoir baissé les taux d'intérêt comme il l'avait exigé de son prédécesseur dans le poste.
La réticence du patron de la banque centrale à s'exprimer sur la politique monétaire laisse toutefois des questions sans réponse quant à son évaluation de l'économie et à la question de savoir s'il s'abstient de donner son avis pour éviter de s'attirer les foudres de la Maison blanche.
Selon le compte-rendu de la réunion de juillet, certains membres du FOMC ont exprimé leurs craintes qu'un report de la hausse des taux n'entraîne par la suite des relèvements plus importants et plus coûteux.
D'autres se sont dits préoccupés par le fait que plus l'inflation resterait longtemps supérieure à 2%, plus les citoyens risqueraient de perdre confiance dans l'engagement de la Fed envers son objectif.
Le comportement du marché obligataire pourrait refléter ces préoccupations, souligne Maurice Obstfeld, professeur d'Economie à l'Université de Californie et ancien chef économiste du Fonds monétaire international (FMI).
"Il est tout à fait possible que les pressions inflationnistes entraînent la nécessité de hausses de taux plus importantes à l'avenir, ce qui explique en partie ces mouvements sur les rendements à long terme... Ce discours est l'occasion idéale de clarifier sa pensée", a-t-il déclaré, tout en ajoutant que le président de la Fed est manifestement en train de trouver ses marques dans un contexte très tendu.

items.title: El Kremlin busca reducir el impacto de los ataques ucranianos en sus exportaciones de grano
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Kremlin dijo el lunes que se estaban adoptando medidas para minimizar el impacto de los ataques ucranianos sobre las exportaciones rusas de granos, mientras los importadores mundiales de trigo se preparaban para una reducción de la oferta en medio de los ataques contra infraestructuras de granos del mar Negro.
items.body:
El Kremlin dijo el lunes que se estaban adoptando medidas para minimizar el impacto de los ataques ucranianos sobre las exportaciones rusas de granos, mientras los importadores mundiales de trigo se preparaban para una reducción de la oferta en medio de los ataques contra infraestructuras de granos del mar Negro.
Los ataques recíprocos de Rusia y Ucrania —ambos grandes exportadores de granos— contra puertos y buques en las últimas semanas han obligado a cerrar terminales de granos y a retrasar o cancelar la carga de decenas de cargamentos durante el periodo álgido de la temporada exportadora.
"Se han definido medidas que seguirán desarrollándose para garantizar que todo el grano destinado a la exportación se despache a tiempo y en su totalidad", dijo a periodistas el portavoz del Kremlin, Dmitri Peskov.
El presidente Vladimir Putin reconoció la semana pasada que Rusia estaba teniendo problemas con sus exportaciones agrícolas, pero dijo que los resolvería. El jefe del Kremlin también aseguró que no habría escasez en los mercados mundiales.
Rusia dispondría de unos 60 millones de toneladas de granos para exportar en la actual temporada, estimó Putin. Las exportaciones rusas de granos aumentarían a 2,2 millones de toneladas métricas en agosto, desde 1,95 millones en julio, según la consultora Sovecon.

items.title: イラン産原油、中国向け供給は既にほぼ途絶－通貨リアルは過去最安値
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： イランのアジア向け原油出荷は、既にほぼ途絶えている。米国はイランとその貿易相手国を孤立させる新たな措置を近く発表する予定だが、発表を前にイラン産原油のアジア向け価格は数年ぶりの高水準となっている。

また、イランの通貨リアルの取引データを追跡するウェブサイト、ボンバストによると、24日の非公式市場でリアルは1ドル＝199万2000リアルと過去最安値を付けた。トランプ米大統領が先週、「いかなる国に対してもこれまで実施されたことのない、最も強力な経済作戦を発表する！」と表明して以降の下落率は4.5%に達した。

非公式取引のデータを収集するもう一つのウェブサイト、TGJUでは23日にリアルは一時1ドル＝200万リアルの節目を割り込んだ。ただ、終値ではやや持ち直した。

イランが輸出する原油の大半は、中国の民間製油会社が購入してきた。だが、ここ数週間はアジアで買い入れが可能なイラン産原油の供給がほぼなくなり、提示価格は世界の原油指標に対してディスカウントから、1バレル当たり4ドル前後のプレミアムへと転じたという。交渉に関与するトレーダーが、匿名を条件に明らかにした。

この供給途絶は、米国の海上封鎖が功を奏している部分が大きい。原油を積載したイランの船舶はペルシャ湾内に閉じ込められ、空荷の船舶は湾外で足止めされている。

調査会社ケプラーによると、その結果、中国などアジアの買い手にとって主要な洋上保管・積み替え拠点であるマレー半島東方の海域にある原油は現在わずか4000万バレルに過ぎず、そのうち売却先が決まっていない原油はわずか400万バレルと見積もられている。これは超大型原油タンカー（VLCC）2隻分でしかない。

ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランを経済的に完全に孤立させる「前例のない規模の」計画を発表する予定だ。中国の石油精製業者や関連企業に資金を提供する銀行が標的となる公算大きい。だが、原油価格が高騰し供給が底を突いている現在、米国の計画に伴う財政的・外交的コストも一段と注目されそうだ。

items.title: Football-Des fans du SC Cambuur blessés par des feux d'artifice lancés par des supporters du Feyenoord
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le club néerlandais du SC Cambuur a indiqué que des supporters avaient subi des brûlures, des lésions auditives et des blessures aux yeux après que des supporters du Feyenoord en déplacement ont lancé des feux d'artifice lors du match de championnat disputé dimanche à Leeuwarden.
items.body:
Le club néerlandais du SC Cambuur a indiqué que des supporters avaient subi des brûlures, des lésions auditives et des blessures aux yeux après que des supporters du Feyenoord en déplacement ont lancé des feux d'artifice lors du match de championnat disputé dimanche à Leeuwarden.
Le match a été interrompu pendant environ 20 minutes en première mi-temps lorsque des supporters dans le secteur réservé aux visiteurs ont allumé un grand nombre de fumigènes et lancé des feux d'artifice. Certains ont été dirigés vers des secteurs du stade où se trouvaient des supporters du Cambuur, tandis qu'un autre a explosé sur le terrain à quelques mètres seulement du gardien de but du Feyenoord, Tjark Ernst.
"Notre propre gardien a vu une torche lancée dans sa direction et a réussi de justesse à l’esquiver", a déclaré le directeur général du Feyenoord, Robert Eenhoorn, qualifiant l’incident de "tout simplement terrible".
Le SC Cambuur a indiqué lundi dans un communiqué que cinq supporters avaient été blessés et que le club collaborerait avec les autorités pour s’assurer que les responsables soient arrêtés.
"Il doit être clair que le fait d’allumer et de lancer des feux d’artifice est totalement inacceptable et n’a absolument pas sa place dans un stade de football", a ajouté le club.
Le maire de Leeuwarden, Foort van Oosten, a également condamné l’incident et promis une enquête, tandis que la Fédération néerlandaise de football a déclaré qu’elle réexaminerait ses protocoles en cas d’incidents de désordre.
Le match a repris malgré les blessures subies par les supporters, mais il aurait été interrompu si un joueur ou un officiel avait été touché.
"Cela ne me semble pas normal", a déclaré à l’agence de presse néerlandaise ANP Jan Bluyssen, responsable des compétitions de football professionnel à la KNVB, la fédération néerlandaise de football.
"Nous devons examiner si le protocole est toujours adapté et comment nous pourrions l’ajuster."
Le Feyenoord s'est imposé 5-2 et reste ainsi invaincu depuis le début de la nouvelle saison de championnat, tandis que le SC Cambuur, nouvellement promu, a perdu ses trois premiers matchs.

items.title: 原油再急騰が米株最大のリスク、エネルギー株でヘッジを－モルガンS
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： モルガン・スタンレーのマイケル・ウィルソン氏は、原油価格の再急騰が米国株にとって最大のリスクだとの見方を示し、ポートフォリオのリスクを低減する手段として、エネルギー株を活用するよう推奨している。

ウィルソン氏によると、原油価格がさらに上昇すれば債券利回りを押し上げ、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のウォーシュ議長は、インフレ率を目標に戻すために対応を迫られる可能性がある。

ウィルソン氏は「対応の中心は財務省よりもFRBになるだろう。最終的にFRBが対応することにほとんど疑いはないが、その前に市場がさらに不安定になる可能性が高い」と述べた。

米イランの戦闘再燃や和平協議の遅れを背景に、北海ブレント原油は7月初旬から約30%上昇し、1バレル＝93ドル前後で取引されている。米30年債利回りは先週、約20年ぶりの高水準近くまで上昇し、米財務省は国債の買い戻しを拡大する方針を発表した。

ウィルソン氏によると、原油価格が上昇した際の株式への打撃は、下落の際の恩恵より大きく、原油相場の安定が株式市場にとって一段と重要になっている。同氏は、原油価格が急騰するリスクへのヘッジとして、エネルギー株を活用することを推奨した。エクソンモービル・ホールディングスとシェブロンの株価は今年30%超上昇し、S&P500種株価指数の上昇率の2倍超となっている。

また、利益が安定し、利益率が高く、効率的な事業運営を行う「クオリティー株」を選好する姿勢も改めて示した。S&P500はクオリティー企業の比重が高く、7月に半導体株主導で相場が下落した際にも、より大幅な下落を免れたという。S&P500は21日、過去最高値を2%弱下回る水準で取引を終えた。

S&P500などの指数の構成も、ウィルソン氏が米国株を海外株より選好する理由の一つだ。同氏は、半導体株が短期的に再び相場の主導役となる可能性は低いとの見通しを示した。

items.title: Temu-owner PDD revenue misses estimates, profit falls on China rivalry
items.author: Harshita Varghese, Casey Hall
items.creator: Harshita Varghese, Casey Hall
items.summary: Chinese e-commerce discounter PDD Holdings reported an 8% rise in second-quarter revenue on Monday that missed market estimates as fierce competition in China and mounting regulatory pressures overseas weighed on growth.
items.body:
Chinese e-commerce discounter PDD Holdings (PDD.O) reported an 8% rise in second-quarter revenue on Monday that missed market estimates as fierce competition in China and mounting regulatory pressures overseas weighed on growth.
The operator of Pinduoduo in China and Temu internationally posted revenue of 112.36 billion yuan ($15.7 billion) for the three months ended June 30, below analysts' average estimate of 116.35 billion yuan, according to LSEG data.
Net income attributable to ordinary shareholders fell 12% to 27.2 billion yuan.
Its shares were up 4.6% in volatile pre-market trading in New York.
PDD competes with Alibaba's (9988.HK) Taobao and Tmall, JD.com (9618.HK) and ByteDance-owned Douyin through discounts, subsidies and incentives aimed at attracting consumers and merchants.
But weak consumer confidence, concerns over job security and a prolonged property downturn have kept shoppers cautious, fuelling a price war across China's e-commerce sector and squeezing margins.
Consumer spending remained subdued even during this year's [USN:L1N42P06M TEXT:""618" shopping festival"], one of China's largest online sales events, despite weeks of promotions and discounts.
PDD has stepped up spending on logistics and merchant support programmes to lower fulfilment costs and improve value for consumers, raising investor concerns that profitability could come under further pressure.
REGULATORY PRESSURES Temu, meanwhile, faces increasing scrutiny in some of its largest overseas markets.
The platform built its international business by shipping low-cost goods directly from Chinese suppliers to overseas consumers, but has been hit by U.S. tariffs on Chinese imports and the end of duty-free treatment for low-value parcels.
Higher shipping and compliance costs have forced some merchants to raise prices, potentially dampening demand among price-sensitive shoppers in the United States and Europe.
Low-value e-commerce goods have also attracted scrutiny, with [USN:L1N4260BB TEXT:"shipments declining"] in recent months as changes to trade rules and tariffs disrupted cross-border sales.
In Europe, policymakers have stepped up efforts to curb the influx of inexpensive goods from China through platforms including Temu, Shein and Alibaba's AliExpress. The European Union's [USN:L6N42Y0OM TEXT:"newly instituted fee"] on small parcels imported directly from China is set to increase costs for sellers and consumers alike, industry analysts say.
The added costs threaten to erode Temu's price advantage and could make it harder for the company to sustain the rapid international growth that has helped fuel investor enthusiasm for PDD.
($1 = 6.7225 Chinese yuan renminbi)

items.title: HINTERGRUND Wie Big Pharma in China trotz Werbeverbot für Abnehmspritzen trommelt
items.author: Andrew Silver
items.creator: Andrew Silver
items.summary: Mit Plakaten in U-Bahnen, Aktionen in Fitnessstudios und sogar Werbung in Fußballstadien kämpfen Pharmakonzerne in China um einen wachsenden Markt für Abnehmspritzen. Direkte Werbung für verschreibungspflichtige Medikamente ist in der Volksrepublik zwar verboten - ähnlich wie in Deutschland. Doch Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly, Pfizer und chinesische Anbieter finden kreative Wege, um Verbraucher auf das Thema Übergewicht - und damit indirekt auf ihre Präparate - aufmerksam zu machen. Die Kommunikationsmaßnahmen gehen dabei weit über das hinaus, was bei anderen Arzneien üblich ist. "Ich sehe selten, dass Pharmaunternehmen verschreibungspflichtige Medikamente gegen Bluthochdruck, Tumore und andere Krankheiten im öffentlichen Raum bewerben, auch nicht durch indirekte Werbung", sagt Jia Hepeng, Professor für Wissenschaftskommunikation an der Universität Soochow.
items.body:
Mit Plakaten in U-Bahnen, Aktionen in Fitnessstudios und sogar Werbung in Fußballstadien kämpfen Pharmakonzerne in China um einen wachsenden Markt für Abnehmspritzen. Direkte Werbung für verschreibungspflichtige Medikamente ist in der Volksrepublik zwar verboten - ähnlich wie in Deutschland. Doch Novo Nordisk (NOVOb.CO) , Eli Lilly (LLY.N) , Pfizer (PFE.N) und chinesische Anbieter finden kreative Wege, um Verbraucher auf das Thema Übergewicht - und damit indirekt auf ihre Präparate - aufmerksam zu machen. Die Kommunikationsmaßnahmen gehen dabei weit über das hinaus, was bei anderen Arzneien üblich ist. "Ich sehe selten, dass Pharmaunternehmen verschreibungspflichtige Medikamente gegen Bluthochdruck, Tumore und andere Krankheiten im öffentlichen Raum bewerben, auch nicht durch indirekte Werbung", sagt Jia Hepeng, Professor für Wissenschaftskommunikation an der Universität Soochow.
Der Markt für die sogenannten GLP-1-Präparate wie die Abnehmspritze Wegovy von Novo Nordisk birgt enormes Potenzial in China. Nach Angaben der Nationalen Gesundheitskommission könnten bis 2030 mehr als 65 Prozent der chinesischen Bevölkerung übergewichtig oder fettleibig sein. Der Umsatz mit Abnehmpräparaten dürfte nach Einschätzung von J.P. Morgan in den nächsten fünf bis sieben Jahren von derzeit drei bis vier Milliarden Yuan auf 30 Milliarden Yuan (vier Milliarden Dollar) steigen. Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly, Pfizer und der chinesische Hersteller Innovent Biologics (1801.HK) kämpfen daher um Marktanteile. Die Unternehmen dürfen zwar über die Risiken bestimmter Krankheiten informieren und dazu aufrufen, einen Arzt aufzusuchen. Produktnamen dürfen sie dabei jedoch nicht nennen.
INTERESSE NIMMT ZU Die Hersteller greifen deshalb zu ungewöhnlichen Methoden. Eli Lilly warb kürzlich in einer Shanghaier U-Bahn-Station mit der Aufforderung, auf das Schnarchen des Vaters zu achten und ein Schlaflabor aufzusuchen. Schnarchen ist ein häufiges Symptom von Schlafapnoe, die eng mit Übergewicht zusammenhängt. Lillys Abnehmspritze Mounjaro kann die Erkrankung lindern. Pfizer veranstaltete gemeinsam mit einer Fitnessstudio-Kette eine "gesunde Abnehm-Party", bei der anschließend Gewichte gestemmt wurden. Der chinesische Hersteller Innovent Biologics wiederum warb auf Plakaten für "wissenschaftliches Gewichtsmanagement" und zeigte dabei ein Maskottchen mit dem Namen "Madudu", der ähnlich wie der Wirkstoff Mazdutide klingt – ohne sein Abnehmpräparat Xinermei zu nennen.
Die Strategie geht offenbar auf. Beeinflusst von sozialen Medien und Empfehlungen aus dem Bekanntenkreis fragen Patienten in Krankenhäusern in Shanghai und Guangzhou gezielt nach bestimmten Abnehmpräparaten, berichteten Klinikmitarbeiter der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Während anfangs vor allem Wegovy von Novo Nordisk gefragt war, werden inzwischen häufiger Mounjaro von Lilly und Xinermei von Innovent genannt. Juristen warnen jedoch, dass einige der Kampagnen die Grenze zur illegalen Medikamentenwerbung möglicherweise überschritten. So könnten Verbraucher die U-Bahn-Plakate von Innovent durchaus mit dem konkreten Präparat in Verbindung bringen, erklärte Chen Zhenggang, Partner bei der Kanzlei DeHeng in Peking.
Die Pharmakonzerne weisen die Bedenken zurück. Eli Lilly erklärte, seine Aufklärungskampagnen würden keine bestimmten Medikamente bewerben und stünden im Einklang mit den Gesundheitsstrategien Chinas. Pfizer und Innovent äußerten sich auf Anfrage nicht. Für Branchenkenner zeigt sich in den Kampagnen der Spagat der Pharmakonzerne. Yang Huang, Leiter der Branchenanalyse Gesundheit für China bei J.P. Morgan, fasste das Dilemma der Pharmabranche mit Blick auf die Aufklärungskampagnen zusammen: "Einerseits versuchen sie definitiv, die Vorschriften einzuhalten, andererseits haben sie Medikamente, die sie verkaufen wollen."

items.title: TSX futures subdued as investors weigh US tariffs, await details on looming Iran sanctions
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Futures tracking Canada's commodity-heavy stock index were subdued on Monday as investors took stock of new U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods and awaited details on United States' threat to impose sanctions against Iran.
items.body:
Futures tracking Canada's commodity-heavy stock index were subdued on Monday as investors took stock of new U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods and awaited details on United States' threat to impose sanctions against Iran.
September futures on the S&P/TSX index were rose 0.1% to 2,147.70 points at 5:41 a.m. ET.
The U.S. [USN:L1N44I0GP TEXT:"imposed"] 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods on Saturday after the two longstanding allies failed to secure a trade agreement, with both sides blaming each other for the collapse of talks.
The new duties add to existing U.S. tariffs on steel, lumber and autos which have taken major hit in the last 18 months. According to trade experts, the tariffs open up some already vulnerable sectors to potential severe damage and could lead to job losses and business closures.
Prime Minister Mark Carney said he had suspended trade negotiations and Canada would retaliate "dollar for dollar" on the new tariffs.
Separately, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who is set to hold a press conference at 2 p.m. EDT (1800 GMT), has [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"threatened"] to roll out "the greatest financial offensive ever" against Iran. President Donald Trump also threatened to impose sanctions on Iran's trading partners.
Oil prices slipped, as investors took profits ahead of the expected announcement. Brent crude futures fell 1.4%, while West Texas Intermediate crude shed 2%.
Gold prices hit a three-month high against a subdued dollar, as investors also turned their focus to key U.S. inflation data due later this week along with Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's remarks at the Jackson Hole symposium in Wyoming.
Spot gold gained 0.7%, while silver shed 0.2%.
Canada's benchmark index [USN:L6N44I11Y TEXT:"recorded"] a 0.3% weekly loss on Friday as investors weighed lingering strains in global bond markets after a [USN:L1N44G0GD TEXT:"U.S. Treasury intervention"] provided brief relief from selling driven by inflation and fiscal concerns.

items.title: Europe’s electronic waste crisis holds the key to supply security – if we act on it
items.author: Aisha Rafique
items.creator: Aisha Rafique
items.summary: Europe faces a paradox: while dependency on critical raw materials threatens our green transition and strategic autonomy, we are not able to sufficiently recover these very materials in our electronic waste streams. The solution isn’t just better recycling – it requires fundamentally rethinking how we design, use and recover electronics.
items.body:
Europe faces a paradox: while dependency on critical raw materials threatens our green transition and strategic autonomy, we are not able to sufficiently recover these very materials in our electronic waste streams. The solution isn’t just better recycling – it requires fundamentally rethinking how we design, use and recover electronics.
Electronic waste has grown 82% globally since 2010 , yet Europe recycles less than 20% appropriately. Meanwhile, China controls over 90% of global rare earth processing , and export restrictions from raw material suppliers have increased fivefold since 2009. As the Draghi report warns , demand for critical minerals will quadruple by 2040 – and we continue melting down functional components containing rare earths and strategic materials at 1,500 degrees Celsius, losing their embodied value forever.
This destruction represents both environmental and economic waste. Printed circuit boards (PCBAs) and electronic components account for up to 70% of a product’s carbon footprint, despite comprising minimal physical weight.
One metric ton of discarded smartphones contains as much gold and copper as 2,000 tons of virgin ore. Yet critical materials and functional components that could serve for decades are lost because conventional pyrometallurgical recycling focuses solely on recovering copper and precious metals such as gold, silver, zinc and lead.
The regulatory environment is shifting rapidly. The Critical Raw Materials Act targets 25% of EU consumption from recycled sources by 2030. Extended producer responsibility schemes are tightening.
Nevertheless, transformation requires more than compliance. It demands cooperation across the value chain, between manufacturers, waste operators and technology providers.
The iPhone recycling robot, Daisy, is seen at an Apple recycling facility in Austin, Texas, U.S. REUTERS/Spencer Selvidge The CIRCUIT project , a collaboration led by Danish Technological Institute, offers one example of this model. Six Danish companies, including electronics manufacturers, PCB suppliers, waste operators and recycling technology, are investigating how increased attention to component removal and repairability could support more circular electronics while maintaining quality standards.
The aim is to help technologies integrate with existing logistics while potentially opening new revenue streams. Waste operators may gain access to higher-value material fractions, manufacturers could strengthen component supply chains and differentiate through documented sustainability, and technology providers can benefit from validation with real waste streams.
There are three strands to the project. First, we must rescue functional components to support reuse. Many PCBAs are encapsulated in sealings that prevent gentle disassembly. In CIRCUIT, we are investigating methods to safely extract components. Combined with in-depth testing and quality assurance, this creates a verified foundation for recovering reusable components for the purpose of repairability.
Second, we need circular design principles embedded from the start. The EU’s Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation will increasingly push manufacturers towards products that are easier to repair, upgrade and disassemble, yet industry still lacks practical frameworks for translating these principles into complex electronics. Rather than treating printed circuit boards as anonymous material streams, we must get better at identifying and extracting components that can extend the lifetime of products already in use.
Third, for components unsuitable for reuse, we need alternative recovery methods. New molten salt technology (offered by Nordic Salt Cycle in the CIRCUIT project) operating at 400-600C – versus 1,200-1,500C in conventional smelters – can potentially be the way to go to selectively extract critical materials at a lower cost than existing technologies.
A worker at Solenthaler Recycling AG, now soREC AG, checks used mobile phones in a transport box in Gossau, Switzerland. REUTERS/Arnd Wiegmann Europe’s dependencies won’t resolve through mining alone. Even with successful domestic extraction, processing capacity takes years to develop. Meanwhile, our waste already contains materials we desperately need. The question isn’t technological feasibility – pilot projects prove that. It’s whether we can scale solutions before the next supply crisis hits.
This requires policy supporting not just collection targets, but also recovery infrastructure. It demands procurement preferences for products designed for circularity. Most crucially, it needs industry to recognise that controlling secondary material flows offers strategic advantages comparable to primary supply access. CIRCUIT shows what this looks like in practice – and aims to offer a blueprint that can be scaled across Europe.
The electronic waste that we currently cannot handle represents tomorrow's supply security. Europe has the technical capability, regulatory momentum, and industrial partnerships needed to capture this value. The only question is whether we'll act with the urgency the situation demands – or wait for the next shortage to force our hand.
CIRCUIT is a collaboration between El Recycling, Danish Technological Institute, HJHansen Recycling Group, NCAB Group, DEIF, LINAK and Nordic Salt Cycle. It is partially funded by The Danish Environmental Protection Agency and has a total budget of 1.2 million euros.

items.title: Reiche-Sprecher zufrieden mit Gasspeicher-Befüllung: keine Mangellage absehbar
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Das von CDU-Politikerin Katherina Reiche geführte Bundeswirtschaftsministerium ist trotz der niedrigen Stände zufrieden mit der Befüllung der Gasspeicher. Ein Sprecher des Ministeriums sprach am Montag in Berlin von einem guten Füllstand der Speicher. Zudem gebe es neue Terminals, um Flüssiggas (LNG) importieren zu können, und auch Pipeline-Lieferungen aus Norwegen. "Entscheidend ist, die Versorgungssicherheit muss gewährleistet sein. Wir sehen derzeit keine Anzeichen dafür, dass es nicht der Fall ist." Eine Mangellage sei nicht absehbar.
items.body:
Das von CDU-Politikerin Katherina Reiche geführte Bundeswirtschaftsministerium ist trotz der niedrigen Stände zufrieden mit der Befüllung der Gasspeicher. Ein Sprecher des Ministeriums sprach am Montag in Berlin von einem guten Füllstand der Speicher. Zudem gebe es neue Terminals, um Flüssiggas (LNG) importieren zu können, und auch Pipeline-Lieferungen aus Norwegen. "Entscheidend ist, die Versorgungssicherheit muss gewährleistet sein. Wir sehen derzeit keine Anzeichen dafür, dass es nicht der Fall ist." Eine Mangellage sei nicht absehbar.
Die staatlich vorgegebene Befüllung der Gasspeicher auf 70 Prozent bis Anfang November ist nach [USN:L8N44I0KG TEXT:"Einschätzung aus der Energiebranche"] kaum mehr zu schaffen. "Das ist irgendwann physikalisch nicht mehr möglich", sagte die Vorsitzende der Hauptgeschäftsführung des Stromlobbyverbandes BDEW, Kerstin Andreae, am Freitag. Es werde trotz hoher Gaspreise beim Einkauf zwar weiter eingespeichert, aber nur langsam. Noch sei die Vorgabe für die Füllstände erreichbar. "Aber es wird immer enger." Die Bundesnetzagentur sieht die Gasunternehmen in der Pflicht. Auch die Bonner Behörde ist skeptisch, dass die staatliche Vorgabe noch erreicht werden kann.
Die Gasspeicher sind derzeit nur etwa zu 50 Prozent gefüllt. Im vergangenen Jahr waren es zum gleichen Zeitpunkt 67 Prozent. Normalerweise können Gashändler im Sommer günstig einkaufen und somit die Speicher füllen, die dann im Winter angezapft werden. Dies ist dieses Jahr aber wegen des Nahost-Krieges, der die Energiepreise nach oben getrieben hat, so nicht möglich. Deswegen zögern viele Firmen.
Klaus Müller, Präsident der Bundesnetzagentur, hält die Füllvorgaben für Gasspeicher für überholt. "Die Speichervorgaben haben sich in der Krise bewährt, aber inzwischen drohen die Fehlanreize zu überwiegen. Einen Mehrwert sehe ich nicht mehr", sagte er zuletzt der "Zeit". Die Vorgaben stammen aus dem Jahr 2022, als die Gasmärkte wegen Russlands Angriff auf die Ukraine in Panik gerieten. Der Sprecher des Wirtschaftsministeriums sagte, man habe die Aussagen zur Kenntnis genommen. "Wir haben die geltende Rechtslage." Er habe keine konkreten Änderungspläne mitzuteilen.
items.raw_description: Das von CDU-Politikerin Katherina Reiche geführte Bundeswirtschaftsministerium ist trotz der niedrigen Stände zufrieden mit der Befüllung der Gasspeicher. Ein Sprecher des Ministeriums sprach am Montag in Berlin von einem guten Füllstand der Speicher. Zudem gebe es neue Terminals, um Flüssiggas (LNG) importieren zu können, und auch Pipeline-Lieferungen aus Norwegen. "Entscheidend ist, die Versorgungssicherheit muss gewährleistet sein. Wir sehen derzeit keine Anzeichen dafür, dass es nicht der Fall ist." Eine Mangellage sei nicht absehbar.

items.title: French parliament will need 'serious' budget talks given bond market tensions
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Rising French government borrowing costs will require "serious" talks in parliament on the country's budget, said government spokeswoman Maud Bregeon on Monday, as the government tries to balance cutting the deficit without hurting consumers too much.
items.body:
Rising French government borrowing costs will require "serious" talks in parliament on the country's budget, said government spokeswoman Maud Bregeon on Monday, as the government tries to balance cutting the deficit without hurting consumers too much.
"All of this will clearly require a lot of rigour," said Bregeon, who also reaffirmed that the government would look to improve the public finance situation and reduce the deficit without imposing tax rises on French citizens.
The yields on French 10-year government bonds reached their [USN:L1N44G0BA TEXT:"highest"] level since 2008 last week, going above 4.13%.
The stage is set for a potentially rocky parliamentary budget battle, as the government seeks to keep the deficit under control ahead of a 2027 presidential election that polls suggest could favour the far right.
French Finance Minister Roland Lescure had also [USN:FWN44J01Q TEXT:"said"] earlier on Monday that the government would do all it could to keep the budget deficit as close as possible to 5%.
The European Commission has [USN:S8N40A022 TEXT:"forecast"] a 2026 French budget deficit of 5.1%, which would be in breach of EU rules stipulating that countries have a 3% ceiling for their deficit.
